thread:
alex: quick check — status of the release corridor? planning cut ~19:00 UTC. who has outstanding cherry-picks?
mira: I have two. #4829 (quantize defaults) is merged but CI is flapping on dedicated tests, rerunning now. flaky: tests/integration/kv_cache_test.
sam: heads-up: PR #4811 is blocked by infra-config change; needs the new ssd instance type in infra-config. pinging @julian for review.
julian: on it. if terraform plan looks good i'll apply. should be ~20–30m.
alex: canary rollout is at 5% on canary-3.0 variant. observability flagged a transient memory spike on host gw-12. does that match any recent kernel/driver churn?
devops-bot: observed host gw-12 memory spike at 18:22 UTC, spike lasted ~90s. no disk pressure. Would you like me to rollback canary to 0%? Reply `yes` to execute: `deploy rollback canary-3.0 --to=0%`.
mira: hold on rollback — i'm running a targeted repro now: ```python perf/repro.py --model=rwkv --seq=2048 --host=gw-12``` warmup shows same short spike but then stable. looks like warmup GC.
sam: CI rerun green for #4829. i'll merge and kick the release job once infra is unblocked.
julian: infra plan OK, pushed change to infra-config branch `release/patch-ssd`, applied. cherrypick for #4811 is now unblocked.
alex: perfect. @mira after your warmup check, if memory is stable bump canary to 10% and start the image tag cut. also confirm image tagging script runs: `scripts/release/tag_image.sh v2026.03.17`.
mira: confirmed warmup explains the short spike. memory stable at +10 minutes. bumping canary to 10% now :white_check_mark:
devops-bot: canary scaled to 10% (canary-3.0) at 18:45 UTC. monitoring for error-rate and latency.
alex: quick checklist before cut: docs updated, release notes drafted, all cherry-picks merged, A/B fallback policy set. status?
sam: docs PR #4833 open and ready to merge (minor wording). release notes draft: /docs/releases/2026-03-17.md (link).
julian: A/B fallback policy set to fallback->canary-2 if error-rate > 2% for 2m. applied.
alex: OK — I'll schedule the cut for 19:05 UTC. any blockers left?
mira: none from infra/runtime testing.
sam: no blockers. merging docs now.
julian: no objections.
alex: thanks everyone. I'll post a short post-cut update in ~30m.
mira: thanks — will watch metrics for the next 20m.
